data.report: November 23, 2026 | 6:19 AM Mostly sunny skies are in the forecast today, with a high near 34°F and calm winds. 11 lifts are scheduled to operate from 9 AM–4 PM, serving 76 open trails across the mountain. Today’s Mountain Tip: Patrol opened the Reverse Traverse yesterday, and terrain off Headwall including The Slot, has been skiing great. Conditions may be a little crunchy in spots, but there are still some fresh turns to be found.
